<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1800027_leve_sys_leave_request</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_1800027_leve_sys_leave_request">requested_byVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="requested_by" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Auto-Populate Country and Approver</name><order>101</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    try {
        gs.info("[Auto-Populate] Starting rule for record: " + (current.number || "new record"));
        
        // Only proceed if we have a requested_by
        if (current.requested_by.nil()) {
            gs.info("[Auto-Populate] No requested_by set, cannot auto-populate fields");
            return;
        }
        
        // Skip if country is already set
        if (!current.country.nil()) {
            gs.info("[Auto-Populate] Country already set to: " + current.country.getDisplayValue());
            return;
        }
        
        // Get user details
        var userGR = new GlideRecordSecure('sys_user');
        if (userGR.get(current.requested_by)) {
            gs.info("[Auto-Populate] Found user: " + userGR.name);
            
            var countryName = "India"; // Default country
            
            // Try to determine country from location if available
            if (!userGR.location.nil()) {
                var location = userGR.location.toString();
                var extractedCountry = extractCountryFromLocation(location);
                
                if (extractedCountry) {
                    countryName = extractedCountry;
                    gs.info("[Auto-Populate] Extracted country: " + countryName + " from location: " + location);
                }
            }
            
            // Find the country record
            var countryGR = new GlideRecordSecure('core_country');
            countryGR.addQuery('name', countryName);
            countryGR.query();
            
            if (countryGR.next()) {
                current.country = countryGR.sys_id;
                gs.info("[Auto-Populate] Set country to: " + countryName);
            } else {
                gs.info("[Auto-Populate] Country not found in core_country table: " + countryName);
                
                // If country record not found, try to create it (if you have permissions)
                try {
                    var newCountry = new GlideRecord('core_country');
                    newCountry.initialize();
                    newCountry.name = countryName;
                    var countryId = newCountry.insert();
                    
                    if (countryId) {
                        current.country = countryId;
                        gs.info("[Auto-Populate] Created and set new country: " + countryName);
                    }
                } catch (ex) {
                    gs.error("[Auto-Populate] Could not create country record: " + ex);
                }
            }
            
            // Set approver if not already set
            if (current.approver.nil() && !userGR.manager.nil()) {
                current.approver = userGR.manager;
                gs.info("[Auto-Populate] Set approver to: " + userGR.manager.getDisplayValue());
            }
        } else {
            gs.info("[Auto-Populate] Could not find user record");
        }
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error("[Auto-Populate] Error: " + e);
    }
    
    // Helper function to extract country from location
    function extractCountryFromLocation(location) {
        if (!location) return null;
        
        // Common location patterns from your data
        if (location.indexOf('London') > -1) return 'United Kingdom';
        if (location.indexOf('Paris') > -1) return 'France';
        if (location.indexOf('Frankfurt') > -1) return 'Germany';
        if (location.indexOf('Rome') > -1) return 'Italy';
        if (location.indexOf('Brasilia') > -1) return 'Brazil';
        if (location.indexOf('Shanghai') > -1) return 'China';
        if (location.indexOf('Melbourne') > -1) return 'Australia';
        if (location.indexOf('Cancun') > -1) return 'Mexico';
        
        // US states
        if (location.indexOf(',FL') > -1 || location.indexOf('Florida') > -1) return 'United States';
        if (location.indexOf(',GA') > -1 || location.indexOf('Georgia') > -1) return 'United States';
        if (location.indexOf(',CA') > -1 || location.indexOf('California') > -1) return 'United States';
        if (location.indexOf('San Diego') > -1) return 'United States';
        if (location.indexOf('Atlanta') > -1) return 'United States';
        if (location.indexOf('Miami') > -1) return 'United States';
        
        // Default to null - will use India as default later
        return null;
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-29 09:40:14</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>c20ba295c303a210a7f1b813e4013187</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Auto-Populate Country and Approver</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Leave Management System" source="x_1800027_leve_sys">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Leave Management System">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_c20ba295c303a210a7f1b813e4013187</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-29 09:40:14</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=c20ba295c303a210a7f1b813e4013187"/></record_update>
